title: Community Health Screening
description: Free community health screening for eligible Singapore citizens.

location.name: Multi-purpose Hall (MPH) and Courtyard, Sultan Mosque Annex Building

registration.instructions: Scan the QR code on the poster to register.

pricing.notes: The screening is advertised as free.

sources.caption:
Come by Masjid Sultan for a meaningful day of health, wellness and community spirit!

🩺 Community Health Screening
🛍️ Mini Bazaar

Bring your family and friends along. Take a little time to care for your health at our Community Health Screening, and enjoy our Mini Bazaar featuring a variety of food, products and activities for everyone!

Come for your health, stay for the community✨

We look forward to seeing you at Masjid Sultan!

#MasjidSultanSG #MenaraSultanSG

🩺 Pemeriksaan Kesihatan Masyarakat
🛍️ Mini Bazaar

Bawa keluarga dan rakan-rakan untuk turut serta. Luangkan sedikit masa untuk menjaga kesihatan melalui Pemeriksaan Kesihatan Masyarakat, dan menikmati Mini Bazaar yang menampilkan pelbagai pilihan makanan, produk dan aktiviti untuk semua!

Datang untuk kesihatan anda, kekal untuk komuniti✨
